name: @hobo/kv-redis-compatible
description: HoBo provider-neutral Redis-compatible key/value authoring and conformance: requirement builders for kv.redis-compatible/v1 and kv.valkey/v1, a declarative conformance suite of pure command cases driven by an injected executor, honestly-scoped consistency claims, the guard that stops list/stream/pub-sub support from being read as a queue or topic capability, and the Redis-protocol binding of the ephemeral-state port (TTL, CAS, counters, locks, capped rings) with its in-memory engine, RESP executor, command meter, and conformance suite.
